_about: Where Carousel Machine's pictures come from (Yarin, 30 Oct 2026: "disconnect my fal account from the carousel machine, use my chatgpt in chrome to create the images so everything will be free"). picture_backend "chatgpt": producer.py never runs fal_generate.py and never needs FAL_KEY; Claude makes every picture in ChatGPT in Yarin's own Chrome (scripts/chatgpt_pictures.py next, scripts/chatgpt_helper.js, chatgpt_pictures.py ingest), free, spend cap 0. picture_backend "fal" turns the old paid fal.ai flow back on (fal_generate.py refuses to run otherwise). Read by carousel_lib.picture_backend(); a missing or unknown value means chatgpt.
